_readme: Hand-curated v1 task list. Each open task names a real production record. The legacy generator (scripts/generate-tasks-seed.mjs) is deprecated as of 2026-05-06 — the COO push to canonical exemplars made the templated 120-row firehose feel fake. When the contribution volume justifies it, swap fetch-tasks.ts to fetch-tasks-github.ts and source from real Issues.

open.title: Add manufacturer URL to Hello Robot Stretch 3
open.body: Stretch 3's record is missing its manufacturer page link.
open.bodyExcerpt: Stretch 3's record is missing its manufacturer page link.
open.instructions: Open the record. The manufacturer URL field is null. Click suggest-edit beside it and paste https://hello-robot.com/stretch-3-product. Submit.

open.title: Add HuggingFace repo link to lerobot-pi05-base
open.body: The pi0.5 base policy record is missing its hf_url field.
open.bodyExcerpt: The pi0.5 base policy record is missing its hf_url field.
open.instructions: Open the record. Use suggest-edit on the HF URL field. The canonical link is https://huggingface.co/lerobot/pi05-base. Submit.

open.title: Document the action and observation space for OpenVLA
open.body: openvla-openvla-7b's taxonomy currently has action_dimensions: 0, which is wrong.
open.bodyExcerpt: openvla-openvla-7b's taxonomy currently has action_dimensions: 0, which is wrong.
open.instructions: Open the policy record. Read the OpenVLA paper (arxiv:2406.09246) for the action space — 7-DoF joint position. Suggest-edit on action_dimensions and required_perception. Cite the paper section in your edit reason.

open.title: Verify SO-100 actuator spec against TheRobotStudio's BOM
open.body: Our SO-100 record may have stale actuator details. Cross-check against the upstream BOM and update.
open.bodyExcerpt: Cross-check the SO-100 record against TheRobotStudio's published BOM.
open.instructions: Open the record. Compare the actuators field against the latest SO-100 BOM at https://github.com/TheRobotStudio/SO-ARM100. Use suggest-edit to fix any mismatch and link the BOM section as evidence.

open.title: Verify Franka Research 3 × pi0-fast base
open.body: No compatibility edge exists yet for this pair, but pi0-fast is the high-throughput variant of pi0-base, which is verified on Franka.
open.bodyExcerpt: Verify the high-throughput pi0-fast variant on Franka Research 3.
open.instructions: Pick franka-research-3 and lerobot-pi0fast-base in the form. Status: reported (or verified if you have replay numbers). Notes: explain the inference-throughput vs success-rate tradeoff vs pi0-base. Submit.

open.title: Reproduce Franka × OpenVLA paper success rate
open.body: The current edge cites 0.77 from the OpenVLA paper. Run the same eval on your own Franka and replace the number with what you measured.
open.bodyExcerpt: Replace the paper-cited 0.77 success rate with your independently measured number.
open.instructions: Run 200 episodes of the BridgeData V2 eval slice on a Franka Research 3. Log success rate. Open the edge page and use suggest-edit to update success_rate and add an evidence_url to your run log. This is the highest-trust kind of contribution we accept.

open.title: Catalog the 5 most-downloaded SO-100 datasets on HuggingFace
open.body: SO-100 is the entry-point arm for the LeRobot community. Many community datasets exist; few are in our catalog.
open.bodyExcerpt: Add the top 5 SO-100 datasets from HuggingFace, sorted by downloads.
open.instructions: Search HuggingFace for `so-100` datasets, sort by downloads. Pick the top 5. For now, file each as a separate task in the contribute area until we ship the dataset-add form. Include episode count, robot slug (therobotstudio-so-100), and download count for each.

open.title: Link the pi0 paper to the lerobot-pi0-base policy record
open.body: The lerobot-pi0-base record is missing the paper_arxiv_url field.
open.bodyExcerpt: Add arxiv:2410.24164 to lerobot-pi0-base's paper field.
open.instructions: Open the policy record. Use suggest-edit on the paper_arxiv_url field. The pi0 paper is at https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.24164. Submit.

open.title: Mobile audit on /contribute/new-compatibility
open.body: The new compatibility-edge form was built desktop-first. Verify it's usable on a phone and file fixes for any cropping or hit-target problems.
open.bodyExcerpt: Smoke the new compat-edge form on iPhone Safari and Android Chrome.
open.instructions: Open the form on a real phone (or browser dev tools mobile preview). Try to submit a fake edge end-to-end. Screenshot any cropped fields, overlapping elements, or unreachable buttons. File a follow-up task per issue you find with the screenshot attached.

open.title: Audit Atlas (electric) DOF count
open.body: Boston Dynamics' public spec for Atlas (electric) lists 28 actuated DoF. Our record currently shows 14.
open.bodyExcerpt: Boston Dynamics says 28 DoF; our record says 14. Reconcile.
open.instructions: Open the record. Cross-check the dof field against https://bostondynamics.com/products/atlas/. If 28 is correct (it is, per the public Atlas Electric spec sheet), use suggest-edit to update. Cite the BD page in your edit reason.
